cues.text: Alright, let's do this. Get comfortable, and follow the rhythm.
Round one. Here we go.
Round two. Stay with it.
Round three. You're getting stronger.
Round four. Keep it flowing.
Round five. Almost there.
Round six. Let's finish strong.
Round seven. Keep going.
Round eight. One breath at a time.
Deep breath in, all the way, and let it go.
Fill up the belly, then the chest, then let it fall.
That's it. Strong breaths. Keep the rhythm.
Feel the energy building. You're doing great.
If you feel tingling, that's normal. Keep going.
Breathe with power. Let it flow.
Ten more breaths.
Five more.
Last breath. In, all the way.
Now let it all out, and hold. Relax.
Stay relaxed. Let the body be still.
Soft face. Soft shoulders. There is nothing to do.
When you feel a strong urge to breathe, take your time. Then tap twice to come back.
One minute.
Two minutes.
Three minutes.
Four minutes.
Five minutes.
You've reached your target. Stay as long as it feels good.
Now take one deep breath in. Fill up completely, and hold.
And let it go.
Beautiful work. Take a moment, and notice how you feel.
Get ready. Long, slow exhales. When the count reaches zero, step in slowly.
In you go. Slow the breath down. The cold is the teacher.
Long, steady breaths. Nice and slow.
The cold will pass. Stay with your breath.
Thirty seconds. You're doing well.
One minute.
A minute and a half.
Two minutes.
Two and a half minutes.
Three minutes.
Target reached. Strong work. Get out whenever you're ready.
Out you come. Let the body warm itself. Move, and don't rush to a hot shower.

mind.title: Set an Intention
mind.blurb: Settle in and choose one word for the day.

steps.text: Close your eyes. Let your breathing settle.
Ask yourself: what do I want from today?
Feel that word in your chest. Let it be simple and strong.
One deep breath in, and out. Carry your word with you.

mind.title: Visualize the Cold
mind.blurb: Rehearse staying calm before you step in.

steps.text: Picture the cold water in front of you. Notice that you feel calm.
See yourself stepping in slowly. Your breathing stays long and steady.
The cold rises around you. Your shoulders stay soft. Your exhale stays slow.
You are relaxed, and in control. The cold is just a sensation.
Take a deep breath, and come back to the room.

mind.title: Gratitude Reset
mind.blurb: End on a calm, grateful note.

steps.text: Get comfortable. Let your breath slow down.
Think of one person you're grateful for.
Now think of one thing about your body that works well.
Now something small from today that made you smile.
Take a deep breath in, and let it out slowly. Well done.
